== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes only use this spell if they are within casting range of a spirit.

== Notes ==
* This skill works on both allied and enemy spirits.
** Allied spirits that are good candidates for this spell are [[Bloodsong]] and [[Vampirism]] (since they heal themselves with their attacks), along with [[Destruction]] and [[Life]] (since they effect upon death).
** The range of the spell is [[casting range]], making it useful even in the remote vicinity of a spirit.
{{anomaly|Can be cast while targeting a spirit, in which case the spirit will lose health and no one will be healed.}}

== Trivia ==
